_readme: Provenance manifest for every hardcoded real-world fact in this repo's calculators. Each entry names the real external source, its real update cadence, when it was last verified against that source (by whom/what commit), whether an automated check exists, and that check's actual verified status. Update this file in the same commit as any data fix. Do not add an entry with a fabricated or unverified source - if a fact's real source hasn't been checked, mark automated_check.status as "missing" and last_verified.method as "never independently verified", don't invent a plausible-looking entry.

entries.description: Every wage figure across the whole site - national percentile curve, state medians, city medians, and job-category medians.

real_source.name: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2025 release
real_source.real_cadence: annual - BLS publishes OEWS in the following spring for the prior May reference period (e.g. May 2025 data released ~April 2026)

last_verified.commit: 6fc563d, f6012dc, f183ec8, d9e6574 (4 commits, one per dataset tier: national/state, city, homepage cross-link, job categories)
last_verified.method: manual audit - downloaded the real BLS OEWS May 2025 national/state/MSA/SOC-code data files directly, matched all 181 cities via component-based real BLS MSA title matching

automated_check.status: RETIRED AND REPLACED 2026-09-08 - see incident history below, then current state

incident_history_2026-05-27_to_2026-09-0.behavior_as_designed: Was meant to fetch BLS series LEU0252881600Q (a Current Population Survey quarterly median-weekly-earnings series) weekly, and if the national figure moved by more than $1,000, proportionally scale every percentile, state median, and city median by that same ratio and auto-commit.
incident_history_2026-05-27_to_2026-09-0.actual_finding_2026-09-08: Series ID LEU0252881600Q does not exist - confirmed by calling the real BLS API directly, which returns 'Series does not exist for Series LEU0252881600Q'. Checked the full run history via `gh run list`: every single run since the workflow's creation on 2026-05-27 (roughly 15 runs, weekly, over 3+ months) has hit this exact error and silently exited 0 with a soft 'transient error' Slack message, meaning it has never once fetched real data or made a commit. It has been reporting a green checkmark in GitHub Actions the entire time while doing nothing.
incident_history_2026-05-27_to_2026-09-0.additional_design_flaw: Even if the series ID were fixed, this design would still be wrong: BLS CPS national median weekly earnings and BLS OEWS per-city/per-occupation wages are two different surveys that don't move proportionally to each other. Proportionally scaling the real, independently-sourced city and category data (from the Aug 31 fix) off an unrelated CPS statistic would silently drift that data away from reality with every triggered run, not toward it - a new, mechanically-generated form of the same fabrication problem this manifest exists to prevent.

automated_check.current_state_2026-09-08: Deleted the broken update-data.yml and scripts/update-data.py entirely rather than patch the series ID. Replaced with the generic data-freshness-check.yml job (same one now used across all 5 properties) - it Slack-alerts once next_check_due passes, and does not fetch or re-derive BLS data itself. This is the same check-only, human-re-audits pattern already used by networthrank's SCF watcher. A real automated re-fetch of BLS OEWS (matching the true annual spring cadence) has not been built - that remains a real gap, just an honestly-flagged one instead of a silently-broken one.
